lens.why: the only lens in the reference set whose editing default IS classical coverage — master + reverse + reaction + insert, cut on the reaction rather than the reveal — which is the thing this book was missing; and its scale grammar (the threat shot from a child's eye height with a human in the near ground) and its firelit palette (amber key, grey-blue-green shadow, one visible hard shaft through haze) are already the cave's own light story.

coverage.law: a scene is an edited sequence: establish once, then alternate; the angle changes between consecutive units unless a hold is declared, and a hold is the same shot still running.
